before: Independent contract review and adjudication before target implementation or MCMC; v1 math accepted, v2 closes prospective diagnostic decision rule before pilot
Independent executable/preflight review and adjudication before real-case MCMC
Independent result review before claims in the user-facing report
after: Independent delta review of JAGS copies and new protocol before JAGS sampling
Independent D/Stan target and executable review before Stan sampling
Independent quantitative result review before final comparative claims

after.historical: Compare old2k vs new20k descriptively; fresh run with same starting seeds/inits is not an independent replication and no prefix equivalence is presumed
after.D_engine: Same target not asserted by mean agreement: independent density/Jacobian/likelihood checks required first
after.MCSE: For the 23 common globals report difference and sqrt(MCSE_JAGS^2+MCSE_Stan^2), plus absolute standardized difference; no equivalence claim unless both relevant precision checks pass. No posthoc tolerance or new posterior acceptance test.
after.group_status: Report global continuous, local, discrete and sampler groups separately as diagnostics; all-target verdict still requires all mandatory targets. No waiver for rare classes or added GQ randomness.

contract_delta.before: separate setup/compile/adaptation/burn/sampling/postprocessing and total elapsed; concurrent-model timings prohibited; seconds alone are not effective precision
contract_delta.after: One four-chain rjags object; A then D and diagnostics sequential; avoid compilation/other sampling during measured processes. Record overlap if accidental; no automatic resampling.

contract_delta.before: Paired exploratory model comparison on one author-packaged empirical case, not inference or numeric reproduction of published estimates
contract_delta.after: New authorized A/D JAGS20k experiment and same-target D Stan2k comparison; old pilot and its verdict preserved

after.parametrization: Noncentered h=alpha+sqrt(v)*z; z~N(0,1); v~Exp(5) on VARIANCE; b0 and alpha kept separate
after.pi: r2,r3 iid Uniform(0,1); pi=(1,r2,r3)/(1+r2+r3). Integrate nuisance u1 exactly; Jacobian u1^2 cancels conditional-uniform density 1/u1^2
after.likelihood: Sum all 3 class-weighted multinomial masses by log_sum_exp per precinct; no clamp or approximate A substitution
after.output: Conditional class probabilities and categorical Z reconstruction per draw; joint M/S and active pA/pW/pO from the SAME Z, plus Rao-Blackwell summaries separately
after.initialization: Map the previous four initial values: alpha/b0/v identical, z=0, r2=.25,r3=.125; no claim seeds match JAGS RNG

runtime_diagnostics.internal_NCP_parameters: All z and r parameters require rank Rhat<1.01, bulk/tail ESS>=400. Common augmented targets retain prior thresholds; NAs never pass.

contract_delta.before: Prospective closure of AD-CONTRACT-QA-01 before any empirical MCMC
contract_delta.after: New explicit user authorization; prior pilot remains immutable, not retrospectively extended or reclassified
